verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gram ingests customer OpenAPI documents to build MCP servers, but nothing shows it publishes a downloadable spec of its own API. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI path returning 404. Consuming OpenAPI as input, llms.txt docs, and the platform MCP server are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
